build: Development build on localhost, PayPal sandbox, Postgres 17

suites.name: Rules engine, routing and the SSA report
suites.what: Every rule row, the 2026 values, the $60 quarterly exclusion, shelter, ABLE, gift routing, pronouns, the reviewers’ referee, the monthly report to Social Security, and the AG Studio to Claude translation

suites.name: API end to end
suites.what: Gift checks, presets, bill and fundraiser reading, the two reviewers, gift pages, the monthly SSA report and its CSV, the MCP server, PayPal orders, routed gifts, fund payouts and their reconciliation, receipts, webhook signature checks, the ledger, developer keys and every error path

suites.name: Browser end to end
suites.what: The Gift Checker, Try it, the two reviewers, a fundraiser turned into a gift page, For agents, the AG Studio dashboard and its assistant, For organizations, the gift page, keyboard use, and the developer flow

suites.name: Accessibility and layout
suites.what: axe WCAG 2.2 AA on 19 pages, including the SSA report as given and as cash, a generated gift page, For agents, the AG Studio dashboard and For organizations, at desktop and phone widths, light and dark, with no sideways scroll

suites.name: Real PayPal checkout, logged in as the sandbox buyer
suites.what: Both PayPal buttons: the buyer logs in and approves, PayPal captures every payee, the page updates, and the public receipt matches

suites.name: An AI agent starts a checkout over MCP
suites.what: The agent calls start_gift_checkout, the sandbox buyer approves the PayPal link, and Giftwise captures on return and shows the receipt

suites.name: Failure cases, live
suites.what: Run the eight failure cases on this page yourself
